_doc: ComfyUI custom node packs the stack declares, pinned upstream. scripts/comfyui/boot.sh reconciles each one to its pinned commit on every start (clone when missing or a zip copy, fetch and detach when drifted, submodules initialised), then installs its requirements.txt (and, for packs that ship a comfy-env-root.toml, builds their isolated pixi worker env via `comfy-env install`). The Ordo-authored packs are not listed here: they live in services/comfyui/nodes/ and boot.sh copies them in. Only declared packs (this file + the repo-owned ones) get their dependencies installed; a pack on the comfyui-app volume that is in neither is left on disk untouched but gets no dependencies. The `name` is the directory under custom_nodes/ (kept equal to the dir the pack already had, so graphs and python_module names do not move). Bump a ref deliberately and say why in the entry's note.

packs.name: ComfyUI-LTXVideo
packs.note: 2026-10-14 master. The May 2026 copy failed to import on ComfyUI 0.41 (interleaved_freqs_cis removed from core); this ref ships the LTX-2.5 graphs, IC-LoRA guides, inpaint preprocess and the looping sampler.

packs.name: VibeVoice-ComfyUI
packs.note: 2026-10-19 v1.8.1 @ b0a8efc. Restored after the 2026-10-16/17 Chatterbox swap dropped it: the dialogue-reel renderer (render_reel_dialogue.py) still posts VibeVoiceSingleSpeakerNode workflows tuned for VibeVoice-Large (seed-11042 pin + pace gate), so both packs coexist — Chatterbox serves dark-patterns-reel narration. Weights: microsoft/VibeVoice-Large bf16 (~18GB) at models/vibevoice/VibeVoice-Large.

packs.name: ComfyUI-Chatterbox
packs.note: 2026-10-16 v2.0.3. OSS Chatterbox TTS (Resemble AI) for the dark-patterns-reel narration, replacing VibeVoice. Node classes ChatterboxTTS/MTLTTS/SRT/Dialog/VC; only extra dep is s3tokenizer. Classic English pack (ResembleAI/chatterbox: ve/t3_cfg/s3gen.safetensors + tokenizer.json + conds.pt) is pre-staged into the comfyui-models volume at tts/chatterbox/resembleai_default_voice so first run does not float-download.

packs.name: ComfyUI-TRELLIS2
packs.note: 2026-07-31 main @ 3e696f2 (upstream HEAD; dev at cdcd578 needs comfy-env 0.4.x). Only change over the May copy (9b87851) is comfy-kitchen in the worker env, which ComfyUI 0.41's comfy/quant_ops imports. The heavy nodes must run in the comfy-env pixi worker (trellis2-nodes): in-process they hit comfy-aimdo lazy weight init and Trellis2ImageToShape dies with StopIteration in model.py's device property. CUDA deps (cumesh_vb, o_voxel_vb_ap, flex_gemm_ap, drtk) come from the pack's nodes/comfy-env.toml via boot.sh's comfy-env step, never the main env.

packs.name: ComfyUI-GeometryPack
packs.note: 2026-07-31 main @ 1cbd144 (upstream HEAD, same comfy-kitchen worker-env fix). Declared because ComfyUI-TRELLIS2 lists it in [node_reqs] and its nodes/comfy-env.toml is solved in the same comfy-env pixi workspace, so an unpinned copy would make the TRELLIS2 env build unreproducible.
